name: br-municipal-taxes
description: Resolve Brazilian municipal tax questions for service providers, service purchasers, property owners and property transferees in 2026. Determine the ISS municipality, service item, ordinary local rate, withholding responsibility and evidence needed before issuing an invoice or calculating a payment. Includes capital-city profiles with item-specific IT, consulting and construction distinctions, conditional local incentives, registration and filing routes, the limits of the national NFS-e rate dataset, and separate Distrito Federal treatment. Covers IPTU versus rural ITR, ITBI valuation, capital contributions and unresolved assignments of acquisition rights. Use for ISS local rates, municipal registration, retained ISS, construction materials, service imports or exports, IPTU and ITBI. Municipal profiles have explicit coverage limits; this is not a complete local tax code for every city.
